name: 11 - API - Find Available Slots - Schedule Guarded V2

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::DATE AS target_date,
        $2::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $3::TEXT AS doctor_name,
        $4::TEXT AS service_name,
        LEAST(GREATEST($5::INTEGER, 1), 20) AS result_limit
),

doctor_context AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS clinic_id,
        c.name AS clinic_name,
        c.timezone,

        d.id AS doctor_id,
        d.full_name AS doctor_name,
        d.buffer_minutes,

        s.id AS service_id,
        s.name AS service_name,
        s.duration_minutes,

        ds.start_time,
        ds.end_time,

        r.target_date,
        r.result_limit

    FROM request_data r

    INNER JOIN clinics c
        ON c.name = r.clinic_name
       AND c.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN doctors d
        ON d.clinic_id = c.id
       AND d.full_name = r.doctor_name
       AND d.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN services s
        ON s.clinic_id = c.id
       AND s.name = r.service_name
       AND s.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN doctor_schedules ds
        ON ds.doctor_id = d.id
       AND ds.is_active = TRUE
       AND ds.weekday = EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM r.target_date)::INTEGER
       AND (ds.valid_from IS NULL OR ds.valid_from <= r.target_date)
       AND (ds.valid_to IS NULL OR ds.valid_to >= r.target_date)
),

generated_slots AS (
    SELECT
        dc.clinic_name,
        dc.doctor_id,
        dc.doctor_name,
        dc.service_name,
        dc.timezone,
        dc.target_date,
        dc.result_limit,

        slot.slot_start_local,

        slot.slot_start_local
            + make_interval(mins => dc.duration_minutes)
            AS slot_end_local,

        slot.slot_start_local AT TIME ZONE dc.timezone
            AS starts_at,

        (
            slot.slot_start_local
            + make_interval(mins => dc.duration_minutes)
        ) AT TIME ZONE dc.timezone
            AS ends_at

    FROM doctor_context dc

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
        dc.target_date + dc.start_time,

        dc.target_date
            + dc.end_time
            - make_interval(mins => dc.duration_minutes),

        make_interval(mins => dc.duration_minutes + dc.buffer_minutes)
    ) AS slot(slot_start_local)
),

available_slots AS (
    SELECT
        gs.*,
        TO_CHAR(gs.slot_start_local, 'HH24:MI') AS available_start_time,
        TO_CHAR(gs.slot_end_local, 'HH24:MI') AS available_end_time

    FROM generated_slots gs

    WHERE gs.starts_at > NOW()

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM schedule_exceptions se

          WHERE se.doctor_id = gs.doctor_id
            AND se.is_active = TRUE
            AND se.exception_type = 'unavailable'

            AND se.starts_at < gs.ends_at
            AND se.ends_at > gs.starts_at
      )

      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM appointments a
          WHERE a.doctor_id = gs.doctor_id
            AND a.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
            AND a.starts_at < gs.ends_at
            AND a.ends_at > gs.starts_at
      )
),

limited_slots AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM available_slots
    ORDER BY starts_at
    LIMIT (SELECT result_limit FROM request_data)
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM doctor_context) THEN FALSE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM limited_slots) THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM doctor_context)
            THEN 'configuration_not_found'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM limited_slots)
            THEN 'no_slots_available'
        ELSE 'slots_found'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM doctor_context)
            THEN 'کلینیک، پزشک، خدمت یا برنامه کاری مطابق ورودی پیدا نشد.'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM limited_slots)
            THEN 'در تاریخ انتخاب‌شده زمان آزادی برای این پزشک وجود ندارد.'
        ELSE 'زمان‌های آزاد با موفقیت پیدا شدند.'
    END AS message,

    r.clinic_name,
    r.doctor_name,
    r.service_name,
    r.target_date,

    (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM limited_slots) AS slot_count,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'start_time', available_start_time,
                    'end_time', available_end_time,
                    'starts_at', starts_at,
                    'ends_at', ends_at
                )
                ORDER BY starts_at
            )
            FROM limited_slots
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS slots

FROM request_data r;

parameters.content:
## نسخه Schedule Guarded V2

این نسخه علاوه بر نوبت‌های موجود، بازه‌های فعال جدول `schedule_exceptions` را نیز از زمان‌های آزاد حذف می‌کند.

ابتدا Workflow شماره 17 را یک‌بار اجرا کن.

**تست داخل n8n:** روی `Execute workflow` کلیک کن.
